episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A frantic young man is running scared in Barcelona. CEO Yoo Jin Woo heads to Granada on a quest after getting a strange call while on business in Spain.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Jin Woo learns that Jung Hee Joo may hold the key. While trying to locate Se Joo, he notices that a new user has entered the immersive virtual universe.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As Jin Woo gets deeper into the game, he encounters a guitarist who looks uncannily familiar, and later makes an offer to Hee Joo that she can't refuse.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Hee Joo and her family are elated over their sudden good fortune. Jin Woo contends with the shocking turn of events and tries to decipher the situation.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Hee Joo makes a shocking discovery. Jin Woo tries to deal with an unwanted visitor at the hospital and thinks he knows what happened to Cha Hyung Suk.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Jin Woo sets out to handle Cha Hyung Suk on his own but is compelled to accept Hee Joo's help. Steeped in doubt, Jin Woo makes an abrupt decision.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The game moves to Seoul. Pursuing a hunch, Jin Woo continues to level up by killing new -- and old -- enemies. Jin Woo notices Hee Joo seems different.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Hearing about Se Joo, Hee Joo is devastated -- and her belief in Jin Woo shatters to pieces. Jin Woo stumbles upon a peculiar behaviour in the game system.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Convinced that only his delusions make any sense, Jin Woo embarks on a secret quest to find Se Joo upon receiving a special message to return to Granada.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Unable to ascertain Seo Jung Hoon's whereabouts, Jin Woo proceeds alone after retrieving a parchment message instructing him to go to Alhambra Palace.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: News of Jung Hoon plunges Jin Woo into a nadir. Attacked from all sides, an old enemy goes on the offense and strikes a blow -- but Hee Joo is there.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: The reopening of Cha Hyung Suk's case worries everyone but Jin Woo asserts he has nothing to hide and tells Hee Joo that he's not going anywhere.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: While news of Jin Woo hits the airwaves, he resumes the quest and has Hee Joo talk with Emma, hoping to get some clues related to the enigma.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: As he levels up further in the game, Jin Woo is ambushed by attackers all around him, but things get more precarious when he's chased by the police.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Se Joo comes home and the quest appears complete, but Jin Woo realizes that there's a bug in the system as he embarks on the final story -- his own.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Se Joo doesn't know who cracked his quest, but Jin Woo deciphers there's a lingering error to fix and disappears without a trace, confounding everyone.
